env.prepare: Prepare the acceptance environment for the Customer Proxy: sandbox, prepare command or service start
presentation.layout: Lay out the story's presentation and its git workspace before the integration tester
quality.lint: Lint the whole repo before the quality step
quality.static: Static analysis of the whole repo before the quality step
quality.coverage: The full suite with coverage, for the quality step's report
checkout.guard: Check the branch and HEAD are the team's before the next step
checkout.verify: Check the branch and HEAD did not move during the step
deploy.preview: Deploy the branch to the preview site
gate.tests-red: Tests gate: the full suite must fail, so the story's new tests are red before any code
gate.tests-rework: Tests gate on a reworked story: the full suite may be red, or green with a tests claim
gate.tests+coverage: Implement gate: the full suite with coverage, once; every test must pass and coverage must meet the threshold
gate.suite-runs: The full suite again, the story's suite_runs times in a row, after its suite step's gate passes
gate.dispute-output: The full suite, to show a disputed test's output
gate.route-lint: Lint and static analysis of the whole repo, to route a failed gate's items to their owners
presentation.trial: The e2e gate: the presentation is complete and its service starts and answers
gate.green: The full suite must pass before the PO passes a story stuck at tests
boundary.sync: Fetch the target and record the team branch; at a sprint end, add the sprint to the review stack
boundary.check: Lint, static analysis, the full suite with coverage, once, and each environment's e2e, on the team branch
boundary.review: Build and check the per-sprint review branches
boundary.push: Push the review branches and open or update their pull requests
boundary.rebase: Rebase the team branch onto the target (sprint end only)
boundary.restack: Bring every review PR up to date, bottom up: rebase, same tree, push, retarget
boundary.ci-wait: Wait for the pull requests' CI checks and read failing logs
runner-tool.run_tests: Only the tests a developer named, run for that developer
runner-tool.run_new_tests: Only the story's new test files, run for a developer
stop.handoff: Stop check: the step's handoff block parses
stop.lint: Stop check: fix the step's changed files with the toolchain's fixers, then lint them
stop.suite: Stop check: the implement gate's suite and coverage, before the developer may stop
stop.red: Stop check: the tests gate, before the unit-tester may stop
stop.presentation: Stop check: the story's presentation is complete, before the integration-tester may stop
